svg.text: Predator and Prey Simulation — Design Patterns
STATE — an animal’s behaviour each tick is decided by its current Mood object
Transitions (each arrow is a return statement inside act(); the switch and the new
mood’s action happen in the same tick, so a prey never loses a step to panicking)
health < 50%, or a mate in range
OBSERVER — World announces what happened; anyone interested subscribes
counts getMood().name() — where the two patterns meet
Before: Main’s timer called update(), repainted both panels, checked for the end,
stopped itself and printed the totals, and World kept the statistics. After: the timer only
calls update(). Adding a new display or logger means one addListener() call, with no edit
Only the classes involved in the two patterns are drawn. The full class design is in design.pdf.
